Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The primary assay is a targeted PRM (Parallel Reaction Monitoring) experiment to quantify the phosphorylation occupancy of Rab10 at Thr73 using SIL (Stable Isotope Labeling) peptides as internal standards (AQUA approach). A separate DDA run was performed specifically for spectral library generation. The 'enrichment' is achieved via SDS-PAGE gel excision of the 20-30 kDa range (where Rab10 resides) rather than a global phosphopeptide enrichment like TiO2.
